operating_model_amendment.effect: Effective at the operator’s merge into `develop` of the PR for governance issue #139 (work ID AI-070), using the adoption mechanism in AGENTS.md §16. The adoption comment, merge SHA and evaluation end date are recorded on that issue.
operating_model_amendment.adoption: The adoption mechanism is the operator’s adoption comment on governance issue #139, posted before merge and citing the SHA-256 of the final authoritative `edit-blocks.json`. The comment explicitly adopts option (b), every changed PACE assignment, and every named correlated-failure exception in 04 §3. The operator-approved merge of that issue’s PR into `develop` makes this amendment effective; the comment alone grants no authority.
operating_model_amendment.option_b: Claude Desktop WUD authoring outside Antigravity qualifications; required document audit before implementation.

exceptions.CF-HOST: Roles 1–17: all local slots share the operator workstation. A host outage can defeat all local levels together. Remote host independence is unknown and never inferred.
exceptions.CF-MODEL: Roles 1/2/11/12/15: a Microsoft-branded surface may use an OpenAI or Anthropic upstream model. Record the actual selected model before dispatch; possible provider overlap is acknowledged, never permission to ignore artifact restrictions.
exceptions.CF-OPTION: Roles 3/5/6/7 and Role 8 outside qualification: Primary Cline × ChatGPT and inactive Alternate Cline × DeepSeek share Cline; Codex is an OpenAI/provider/account substitution inside Primary, not another level. Claude Desktop WUD author and Claude Code fallback share Anthropic, so fallback remains unavailable until the WUD is substantively authored by ChatGPT and audited as required; Codex must review.
exceptions.CF-BOUNDED: Roles 4/8 assessed classes: inactive Alternate and Contingency Cline routes share Cline; Contingency Codex and Cline × ChatGPT share OpenAI/account. No independent extra level is claimed.
exceptions.CF-DISCOVERY: Role 9 Alternate ChatGPT and Emergency Cline × ChatGPT share OpenAI and the ChatGPT Plus account; both may fail together.
exceptions.CF-GITHUB: Roles 10/16 Alternate ChatGPT and Contingency Cline × ChatGPT share OpenAI/account; Contingency and inactive Emergency share Cline. Copilot’s actual upstream model can add provider overlap and must be checked.
exceptions.CF-CONTENT: Role 12 Primary ChatGPT and Emergency Cline × ChatGPT share OpenAI/account. M365 remains bounded-review-only and can add upstream overlap.
exceptions.CF-PLACEMENT: Role 13 Primary ChatGPT and Contingency Cline × ChatGPT share OpenAI/account; Contingency and inactive Emergency share Cline. This acknowledges backup correlation, not permission for self-placement.
exceptions.CF-AUDIT: Role 14 Primary Claude Desktop and Emergency Claude Code share Anthropic provider and account. Exhaustion or provider failure can remove both; Anthropic-authored documents have only ChatGPT Alternate.
exceptions.CF-REVIEW: Role 17 local Primary and Alternate share the workstation. The option-(b) Anthropic WUD author and Claude Code reviewer share provider/account across roles. Distinct-agent code review remains required; no three-vendor independence is claimed.

operating_model_amendment.capacity: When the shared Claude allowance is exhausted, Role 14 Primary and Emergency fail together, and option-(b) WUD authoring stops. New work that needs either service waits. Work whose WUD is already authored and validly audited may proceed only while its implementation and review lanes remain eligible and available; an exhausted Claude Code review lane may use independent Codex review where permitted. When ChatGPT Plus is exhausted, the option-(b) Primary, the ChatGPT authorship precondition for the Claude Code fallback, and Role 17 Alternate fail. An existing ChatGPT-authored, validly audited WUD does not require fresh authorship solely because of that exhaustion, but still needs an available independent reviewer. No paid route is added. Record blocked-work duration and cause, including authoring, audit, implementation and review delays, on the governance issue as evaluation evidence.
operating_model_amendment.history: All original configuration values and confirmed-via-retest notes are preserved in historical_roster_2026_10_01. No current model/effort/entitlement is inferred.
operating_model_amendment.role_2: Both pending bounded specification tests retained.
operating_model_amendment.role_11: Assignments unchanged; no paid execution granted.
operating_model_amendment.slot_configuration: Before dispatch record actual model, effort, tier, tool surface, non-secret account and host references, verification date and qualification evidence.
